class Convert2Rel(BatchOp):

)

or for the 5th grade reading level (but referencing the specific feature label in Peferences):

class Convert2Rel(BatchOp):
title = ("Convert paths from absolute to relative")
description = (
"This tool helps simplify long file paths and consolidate Media collections. "

"You can set this base path in the Preferences. "
"If you don't set it, the tool will use your Gramps User Directory instead. "
"Relative paths are helpful because they make it easier to move your files "
"to a new computer or folder without breaking anything."
)
